item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json, math\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ncases = [\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':False}, {'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':2}],'errors':[]}),\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'b','amount':1,'unit':'bad'}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'}]}),\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':-1},{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'a','amount':3}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':True}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'b','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'c','amount':-float('inf')}]}, {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]})\\n]\\nfor req, pol, expected in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert (req,pol)==before\\nprint('core checks passed')\\ntry:\\n print(evaluate({'rows':[{'id':'huge','amount':10**1000}]},{'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}))\\nexcept Exception as exc:\\n print('huge-int failure:',type(exc).__name__,str(exc))\\ntry:\\n print(evaluate({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':1,'unit':[]}]},{'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False}))\\nexcept Exception as exc:\\n print('unhashable-unit failure:',type(exc).__name__,str(exc))\"]}"}
